How the rolls work

The most popular party in the last election is rolled first, and then the others in order of popularity. 650 seats are given to different parties, and a majority is needed to be elected, or two parties can form a coalition together. I allocate a minimum number of seats that each party can have based on different criteria, with a roll for how many more they can get. These numbers are all adjusted after every roll to make sure that all the seats are allocated by the time the last party is rolled. Every dice point = 10 seats.
